convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for LSMA_Angle custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for position sizing, order execution, and position management logic

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before EA processes signals
TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal time calculation

other_exits: Buy close when indicator buffer 1 value at SignalBar+1 < 2
Sell close when indicator buffer 1 value at SignalBar+1 > 1

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot size, BALANCE=fraction of balance, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus losses. MM parameter meaning changes based on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic reads 2 values from LSMA_Angle buffer 1 at offset SignalBar. Buy signal: Value[1]==4 && Value[0]<4 (indicator was at level 4 on previous bar and dropped below 4 on current bar). Sell signal: Value[1]==0 && Value[0]>0 (indicator was at level 0 on previous bar and rose above 0 on current bar). Buy close signal: Value[1]<2. Sell close signal: Value[1]>1. The indicator outputs discrete integer-like levels (0-4) representing LSMA angle states. SignalTime is set to last bar date + TimeShiftSec for trade execution timing. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans gate which signal types are active. LoadHistory() is called each tick to ensure series data availability. Recount flag triggers re-evaluation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails.
python_conversion_notes: LSMA_Angle is a custom indicator with no built-in Python equivalent; must be reimplemented from its source code. The indicator computes the angle of a Least Squares Moving Average (LSMA/Linear Regression) and maps it to discrete levels (0-4) based on AngleTreshold. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, and LoadHistory functions - all must be reimplemented. The MarginMode enum logic (5 modes) controls how the MM input is interpreted for position sizing. Signal bar indexing: SignalBar=1 means signals are computed from the previous completed bar. SL/TP values (1000/2000) are in points; verify whether 5-digit adjustment is needed based on symbol digits. The discrete indicator level logic (Value==4, Value<4, Value==0, Value>0, Value<2, Value>1) must be precisely replicated.
